user.title: Claude Code Usage
user.description: Creates a webhook that the push script on each computer sends its hourly Claude Code token usage to.

reconfigure.title: Webhook URL
reconfigure.description:
Current webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`

If only the `/api/webhook/...` path is shown, prefix it with the address you use to reach Home Assistant from outside (e.g. `https://ha.example.com`). Set an external URL under Settings → System → Network to see the full URL here.

If it has leaked, regenerate it. Every computer then has to run `install --webhook` again with the new URL.

create_entry.default:
Give this webhook URL to the push script on each computer (`install --webhook <URL>`):

`{webhook_url}`

If only the `/api/webhook/...` path is shown, prefix it with the address you use to reach Home Assistant from outside (e.g. `https://ha.example.com`). Set an external URL under Settings → System → Network to see the full URL here.

You can view it again later under Reconfigure.
